meta.note: Draftly is a SwiftUI and AppKit app. It uses macOS semantic colors. Color values are the macOS resolved values for light and dark appearance.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Editor and draft list background (NSColor.textBackgroundColor). The default dark canvas is black.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window chrome and sidebar ground behind panels (NSColor.windowBackgroundColor).

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Approximation of .regularMaterial. Use for floating banners and status overlays only.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, window and material (Color.primary, NSColor.labelColor).

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: list previews, folder heading, toolbar and footer symbols (.secondary). Source pair: on canvas in light it measures about 3.9:1, below 4.5:1 for small text. Keep it for symbols and 13px+ meta text; do not use it for long body copy. High contrast: #4a4a4a, 7.9:1 or more on canvas, window and material.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and placeholder text (.tertiary). Decorative only; it does not meet text contrast. High contrast: #6b6b6b, 4.8:1 or more; still for disabled controls only.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the dashed row separator (used at 45% strength under draft rows). High contrast: #767676, 4.0:1 or more on canvas and window.

tokens.name: fill-track
tokens.usage: Capsule track behind FolderControl (primary at 6.5%).

tokens.name: fill-selected-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected FolderControl segment when the window is inactive (primary at 9%).

tokens.name: divider-segment
tokens.usage: 1 x 16px divider between unselected FolderControl segments (primary at 22%).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline on controls and floating surfaces: FolderControl track, inactive selected segment, banners, status overlay. Invisible in Light and Dark; #595959 in High contrast, 5.9:1 or more on fill-track, canvas and window.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: System accent (Color.accentColor, systemBlue). Selected segment fill, active toggle symbols, default action-bar icons, default editor heading color. White text on accent passes 4.0:1 in light; use it for 13px+ semibold labels and icons. High contrast: #0040a8, 8.2:1 or more on canvas and window; on-accent text on it 9.1:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on accent fills: selected FolderControl segment and the emphasized draft row.

tokens.name: on-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Preview text in an emphasized (selected) draft row. High contrast: solid white, 9.1:1 on accent.

tokens.name: on-accent-tertiary
tokens.usage: Date text in an emphasized draft row. Decorative strength; the date is also readable in the unselected row. High contrast: #e6ecf8, 7.7:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tag chip fill in the editor tag strip (accent at 14%). The draft list uses 10%.

tokens.name: accent-tint-border
tokens.usage: 0.5px tag chip border in the editor tag strip (accent at 35%). The draft list uses 25%.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in the editor when Link Mode is on (NSColor.linkColor). Text on canvas. High contrast: #0040a8, 8.2:1 or more.

tokens.name: system-red
tokens.usage: Error banner symbol and border, destructive swipe action, flag 1 (Red), red action tint. High contrast: #5c000b, 14.4:1 on canvas, and 3.4:1 apart from system-green in lightness, so error and success differ without hue.

tokens.name: system-orange
tokens.usage: Warning banner, flag 2, inline code and @tags in the editor, word and indent commands in the action bar. Below 3:1 on a light canvas: pair with a symbol or shape. High contrast: #a14700, 5.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: system-yellow
tokens.usage: Flag 3, Move Left and Move Right action-bar commands. Below 3:1 on a light canvas: never use for text. High contrast: #755800, 5.9:1 or more.

tokens.name: system-green
tokens.usage: Success banner, flag 4, find and dictation commands. Below 3:1 on a light canvas: pair with a symbol. Success and error differ by hue only; the banner symbol (checkmark vs xmark) carries the meaning. High contrast: #3a8c16, 3.8:1 or more on canvas and window (marks only); 3.4:1 lighter than system-red.

tokens.name: system-blue
tokens.usage: Info banner, flag 5, default action-bar commands, Markdown links and TaskPaper projects in the editor, non-destructive swipe action.

tokens.name: system-purple
tokens.usage: Flag 6, Toggle Tasks command, highlighted syntax scope in the editor.

tokens.name: system-pink
tokens.usage: Pink action tint only.

tokens.name: system-teal
tokens.usage: Task checkboxes and interactive task ranges in the editor.

tokens.name: system-gray
tokens.usage: Flag 7 (Gray) and gray action tint.

tokens.name: theme-foreground
tokens.usage: Default foreground of a new custom editor theme (EditorThemeDefinition). Text on theme-background, 16:1.

tokens.name: theme-background
tokens.usage: Default background of a new custom editor theme.

tokens.name: theme-heading
tokens.usage: Default Markdown heading color of a new custom editor theme. Falls back to system-blue when no theme is set.

tokens.name: preview-link
tokens.usage: Link color in the Markdown HTML preview. Source value is 3.4:1 on white; keep for links, which are also underlined by context. High contrast: #0040a8, 9.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: preview-code-fill
tokens.usage: Inline code and pre block fill in the Markdown HTML preview.

tokens.name: preview-rule
tokens.usage: Horizontal rule in the Markdown HTML preview.

tokens.name: preview-quote-border
tokens.usage: 3px left border of blockquotes in the Markdown HTML preview.

tokens.name: icon-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Bottom-left stop of the app icon gradient (sampled from Draftly.icns). Brand mark only, never UI.

tokens.name: icon-gradient-end
tokens.usage: Top-right stop of the app icon gradient (sampled from Draftly.icns). Brand mark only, never UI.

styles.name: editor-body
styles.usage: Default editor text: System 17pt. The person can change font and size in Settings.

styles.name: editor-mono
styles.usage: Capture search editor and the monospace scope style.

styles.name: preview-body
styles.usage: Markdown HTML preview body, max width 760px.

styles.name: list-heading
styles.usage: Folder name above the draft list, in label-secondary; the active tag filter follows in label.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: First line of a draft in its row.

styles.name: row-preview
styles.usage: Up to three preview lines, joined with a bullet. Semibold when it shows a search match.
styles.sample: Call Ana • Book flights • Review PR

styles.name: row-meta
styles.usage: Tag chips and the modified date in a row.

styles.name: row-last-action
styles.usage: Last action name under a row when that option is on.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: Sheet titles such as Draft Info.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headings in settings and editors.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Body text, text action-bar labels, empty-state messages, banners.

styles.name: tag-strip
styles.usage: Tag chips and token field in the editor tag strip; footer syntax menu.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Editor footer statistics (tabular digits) and filter summary line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, status overlay text, group names in the command palette.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Stack spacing between draft row lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between tag chips.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Title-to-flag gap in a row; editor horizontal margin default.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tag chip horizontal padding; row horizontal inset; compact footer gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Status overlay vertical padding; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Banner icon-to-text gap; empty-state stack; list control insets.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Banner padding; overlay padding; action bar horizontal padding; utility leading gap.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Regular footer gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: List heading horizontal padding; form stacks.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Sidebar inset; sheet stacks.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between action-bar buttons; tag strip horizontal padding; palette padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Sheet padding (Draft Info).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Empty-state top offset.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Inline code and pre blocks in the Markdown preview.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tag chips (continuous corner) and the flagged-row highlight.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Editor status overlay.

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Action message banner.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: FolderControl track and its selected segment (Capsule).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default sidebar panel width.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Default draft list panel width.

tokens.name: actions-width
tokens.usage: Default actions panel width.

tokens.name: utility-height
tokens.usage: Draft list utility bar height.

tokens.name: list-title-height
tokens.usage: Folder heading row height.

tokens.name: folder-control-height
tokens.usage: FolderControl capsule height.

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: Draft list search field height.

tokens.name: tag-strip-height
tokens.usage: Editor tag strip height.

tokens.name: editing-bar-height
tokens.usage: Action bar height under the editor.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: Editor footer height.

tokens.name: row-pitch
tokens.usage: Draft row pitch with two preview lines.

tokens.name: banner-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of an action message banner.

tokens.name: panel-icon
tokens.usage: Hit area of panel icons (20px glyph inside).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Editor status overlay. The only shadow in the app; panels use material and hairlines instead.
